blockers.criterion: 5. Setup Modal Interaction: shows copyable installation instructions when the binary is not on PATH (spec 4.3.3 Scenario A, e.g. `uv tool install graphifyy`)
blockers.reason: installOf() copies everything before the first comma, so for the built-in graphify setup text ('uv tool install graphifyy (or pipx install graphifyy), then build the graph ...') the Copy button copies 'uv tool install graphifyy (or pipx install graphifyy)'. Pasted into a shell, that is a syntax error, not an install command. The existing test only checks graft. A test should call indexerPresentation({ name: 'graphify', command: 'graphify', index: 'graphify-out/graph.json', installed: false, indexed: false, setup: CODE_INDEXERS.graphify.setup, build: CODE_INDEXERS.graphify.build, canBuild: false }, false) and expect copyText to be 'uv tool install graphifyy', with the alternative ('or pipx install graphifyy') and the build step in copyInstructions.
